name: auto-research
description: Run research campaigns that split your question into subquestions, delegate them to agents, and stream findings. Campaigns continue unattended until answered or stalled. Send the final report to your knowledge library or a shareable artifact.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Expands one broad question into a scoped tree of sub-questions before spending agent time
Campaigns keep researching between your check-ins, with findings streamed live
Notices when a campaign stops making progress instead of looping forever
Attended mode pauses to ask you a question when it needs a decision; unattended runs straight through
Add follow-up questions mid-campaign without starting over
Start, pause, and resume any campaign from the dashboard
Export the finished report to your knowledge library or a shareable artifact
useCases: Run a multi-cycle investigation that expands a broad question, streams evidence, and produces a reusable report.
configuration: Create a campaign, choose Agent or Dynamic Workflow mode, expand the question, then set cycles, interval, workers, and attended or unattended operation.
